content:
Time questions in Class 4 use the 24-hour clock, elapsed time and the calendar — small facts, easy marks, frequent slips. Here is what the Maths Olympiad Class 4 time chapter tests, the facts to memorise, and a free 10-question test.

What the Class 4 Maths Olympiad Time chapter tests

  • The 24-hour clock (conversions both ways)
  • Elapsed time across hours and noon/midnight
  • The calendar, days between dates and leap years
  • Conversions (seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks)

Key facts your child should know

  • For p.m. (except 12 p.m.) add 12: 3:30 p.m. = 15:30; midnight = 00:00.
  • Count elapsed time in steps: to the next hour, then whole hours, then the rest.
  • 1 h = 60 min; 1 min = 60 s; 1 day = 24 h; 1 week = 7 days.
  • Leap year: divisible by 4 (century years by 400) — February gets 29 days.

Common mistakes to avoid

  • Adding 12 to a.m. times when converting to 24-hour.
  • Miscounting elapsed time across noon or midnight.
  • Forgetting the leap-year rule for century years.

quiz.title: IMO Class 4 Time Quiz
quiz.intro: Ten Olympiad-pattern questions. Pick an answer for each, then press Check my score.

questions.q: An exam begins at 10:40 am and lasts 2 h 35 min. At what time does the exam end?
questions.explanation: 10:40 am + 2 h 35 min takes us past 12 noon: the end time is 1:15 pm.

questions.q: How many days come strictly between 25 April and 9 May, leaving out both dates?
questions.explanation: After 25 April there are 5 days left in April, and before 9 May there are 8 days: 5 + 8 = 13 days.

questions.q: The station clock shows 13:05. What time is this on a 12-hour clock?
questions.explanation: 13:05 is past 12 noon, so subtract 12 from the hours: 13 - 12 = 1. The time is 1:05 pm.

questions.q: A chemistry practical begins at 09:35 and goes on for 2 h 20 min. Write the finishing time on the 24-hour clock.
The station clock shows 15:10. What time is this on a 12-hour clock?
questions.explanation: 15:10 is past 12 noon, so subtract 12 from the hours: 15 - 12 = 3. The time is 3:10 pm.

questions.q: A delivery van leaves the warehouse at 16:50 and goes on for 3 h 5 min. Write the finishing time on the 24-hour clock.
A handicraft exhibition runs from 18 November to 3 December, counting both dates. For how many days is it open?
questions.explanation: November gives 13 days (from 18 to 30, both counted) and December gives 3 more: 16 days in all.

questions.q: A ferry sets off at 09:50 and docks at 15:35. How long is the crossing?
questions.explanation: From 09:50 to 15:35 is 5 h 45 min (count on to the next full hour, then add the rest).

questions.q: The egg timer was set to 6 min 20 s. How many seconds is that?
A summer camp runs from 25 March to 8 April, counting both days. For how many days does the camp run?
questions.explanation: March has 31 days: from 25 March to 31 March is 7 days (both counted), then 8 more days of April gives 15 days.

faq.a: 2:20 p.m. — subtract 12 from hours 13 and above.

faq.q: How do you count elapsed time?
faq.a: Count on from the start: to the next full hour, then whole hours, then the leftover minutes, and add the pieces.
